About Ahmad

Creative thinking, practical design.

I approach graphic design as a combination of visual communication, creativity and problem-solving. My goal is not simply to make something attractive—it is to make the message clear and the final design useful.

For the last six months, I have been applying my design skills to Etsy, creating digital products and learning how design, presentation and customer needs work together in an online marketplace.
